# Loading raw Data

```{python}
#| label: load-raw
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

survey_path = Path("simulated_commuter_survey_2020_26_messy.csv")
population_path = Path("population_addresses_messy.csv")

survey = pd.read_csv(
    survey_path,
    dtype={"zip": "string"}
)

population = pd.read_csv(
    population_path,
    dtype={
        "current_zip": "string",
        "permanent_zip": "string"
    }
)

print("COMMUTER SURVEY")
print(f"Loaded raw file: {survey_path}")
print(f"Rows: {len(survey)}")
print(f"Columns: {len(survey.columns)}")
display(survey.head())

print("\nPOPULATION ADDRESSES")
print(f"Loaded raw file: {population_path}")
print(f"Rows: {len(population)}")
print(f"Columns: {len(population.columns)}")
display(population.head())
```

# Clean the Data and Display the Data

```{python}
#| label: Cleaning and logging the data

from IPython.display import display

survey_clean = survey.copy()
survey_log_rows = []

def log_survey(row_index, respondent_id, year, column, old_value,
               new_value, action, note):
    survey_log_rows.append({
        "row_index": row_index,
        "respondent_id": respondent_id,
        "year": year,
        "column": column,
        "old_value": old_value,
        "new_value": new_value,
        "action": action,
        "note": note
    })

print("Raw survey rows:", len(survey))
print("Clean survey rows:", len(survey_clean))

missing_id_rows = survey_clean[
    survey_clean["respondent_id"].isna()
    | survey_clean["year"].isna()
]

print("Rows with missing respondent_id or year:", len(missing_id_rows))
display(missing_id_rows)

## Check for duplicate respondent-year combinations

duplicate_rows = survey_clean[
    survey_clean.duplicated(
        subset=["respondent_id", "year"],
        keep=False
    )
]

print("Rows involved in duplicate respondent-year combinations:",
      len(duplicate_rows))
display(duplicate_rows)
```

```{python}

## Check commuting values and transportation percentages

# Check days commuting
days_numeric = pd.to_numeric(
    survey_clean["days_commuting"],
    errors="coerce"
)

invalid_days = survey_clean[
    days_numeric.notna()
    & ~days_numeric.between(1, 7)
]

print("Rows with numeric days_commuting outside 1-7:",
      len(invalid_days))
display(invalid_days.head(10))


# Check nonnumeric values separately
nonnumeric_days = survey_clean[
    survey_clean["days_commuting"].notna()
    & days_numeric.isna()
]

print("Rows with nonnumeric days_commuting values:",
      len(nonnumeric_days))
display(nonnumeric_days.head(10))


# Check trips per week against the expected relationship
trips_numeric = pd.to_numeric(
    survey_clean["trips_per_week"],
    errors="coerce"
)

trip_mismatch = survey_clean[
    days_numeric.notna()
    & trips_numeric.notna()
    & (trips_numeric != 2 * days_numeric)
]

print("Rows where trips_per_week is not twice days_commuting:",
      len(trip_mismatch))
display(trip_mismatch.head(10))

# Check transportation percentage columns

pct_columns = [
    column for column in survey_clean.columns
    if column.startswith("pct_")
]

# Convert percentages to numbers for checking only
pct_numeric = survey_clean[pct_columns].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce"
)

# Check percentages outside 0-100
invalid_pct_rows = survey_clean[
    ((pct_numeric < 0) | (pct_numeric > 100)).any(axis=1)
]

print("Rows with percentages outside 0-100:", len(invalid_pct_rows))
display(invalid_pct_rows.head(10))


# Check percentage totals
pct_totals = pct_numeric.sum(axis=1, min_count=len(pct_columns))

pct_mismatch = survey_clean[
    pct_totals.notna() & ((pct_totals - 100).abs() > 0.1)
]

print("Rows where transportation percentages do not sum to 100:",
      len(pct_mismatch))
display(pct_mismatch.head(10))


# Check for nonnumeric percentage values
nonnumeric_pct_rows = survey_clean[
    survey_clean[pct_columns].notna().ne(pct_numeric.notna()).any(axis=1)
]

print("Rows with nonnumeric percentage values:",
      len(nonnumeric_pct_rows))
display(nonnumeric_pct_rows.head(10))


# Check for negative distances
distance_numeric = pd.to_numeric(
    survey_clean["distance_to_campus_miles"],
    errors="coerce"
)

negative_distance = survey_clean[
    distance_numeric.notna()
    & (distance_numeric < 0)
]

print("Rows with negative distance:", len(negative_distance))
display(negative_distance.head(10))

# Check for nonnumeric distance values
nonnumeric_distance = survey_clean[
    survey_clean["distance_to_campus_miles"].notna()
    & distance_numeric.isna()
]

print("Rows with nonnumeric distance values:",
      len(nonnumeric_distance))
display(nonnumeric_distance.head(10))


# Check weeks per year
weeks_numeric = pd.to_numeric(
    survey_clean["weeks_per_year"],
    errors="coerce"
)

invalid_weeks = survey_clean[
    weeks_numeric.notna()
    & ~weeks_numeric.between(0, 52)
]

print("Rows with weeks_per_year outside 0-52:",
      len(invalid_weeks))
display(invalid_weeks.head(10))

# Check for nonnumeric weeks_per_year values
nonnumeric_weeks = survey_clean[
    survey_clean["weeks_per_year"].notna()
    & weeks_numeric.isna()
]

print("Rows with nonnumeric weeks_per_year values:",
      len(nonnumeric_weeks))
display(nonnumeric_weeks.head(10))


# Check year formatting
valid_years = [
    "2020-21", "2021-22", "2022-23",
    "2023-24", "2024-25", "2025-26"
]

invalid_years = survey_clean[
    ~survey_clean["year"].astype("string").isin(valid_years)
]

print("Rows with unexpected year values:", len(invalid_years))
display(invalid_years[["respondent_id", "year"]].head(10))
```


```{python}

# Step 1: Remove extra spaces from text values

text_columns = survey_clean.select_dtypes(
    include=["object", "string"]
).columns

for column in text_columns:
    for row_index in survey_clean.index:
        old_value = survey_clean.at[row_index, column]

        if isinstance(old_value, str):
            new_value = old_value.strip()

            if old_value != new_value:
                survey_clean.at[row_index, column] = new_value

                log_survey(
                    row_index,
                    survey_clean.at[row_index, "respondent_id"],
                    survey_clean.at[row_index, "year"],
                    column,
                    old_value,
                    new_value,
                    "changed",
                    "Removed extra spaces around text"
                )

# Show the number of changes made
survey_change_log = pd.DataFrame(survey_log_rows)

print("Text formatting changes made:", len(survey_change_log))
display(survey_change_log.head(20))
```

``` {python}

# Step 2: Convert columns that should be numeric

pct_columns = [
    column for column in survey_clean.columns
    if column.startswith("pct_")
]

numeric_columns = [
    "days_commuting",
    "trips_per_week",
    "weeks_per_year",
    "distance_to_campus_miles",
    "mtcde_est"
] + pct_columns

numeric_changes = 0
numeric_flags = 0

for column in numeric_columns:
    original_values = survey_clean[column].copy()

    converted_values = pd.to_numeric(
        original_values,
        errors="coerce"
    )

    for row_index in survey_clean.index:
        old_value = original_values.loc[row_index]
        new_value = converted_values.loc[row_index]

        # Flag nonblank values that could not be converted
        if pd.notna(old_value) and str(old_value).strip() != "" and pd.isna(new_value):
            log_survey(
                row_index,
                survey_clean.at[row_index, "respondent_id"],
                survey_clean.at[row_index, "year"],
                column,
                old_value,
                None,
                "flagged",
                "Could not convert value to a number"
            )
            numeric_flags += 1

        # Record numeric values that were stored as text
        elif isinstance(old_value, str) and pd.notna(new_value):
            log_survey(
                row_index,
                survey_clean.at[row_index, "respondent_id"],
                survey_clean.at[row_index, "year"],
                column,
                old_value,
                new_value,
                "changed",
                "Converted text value to numeric"
            )
            numeric_changes += 1

    survey_clean[column] = converted_values

print("Text values converted to numbers:", numeric_changes)
print("Nonblank values flagged as nonnumeric:", numeric_flags)

# Update the change log to include both cleaning steps
survey_change_log = pd.DataFrame(survey_log_rows)

print("Total survey log entries:", len(survey_change_log))
display(survey_change_log.head(20))

# Inspect categorical values before standardizing them
category_columns = [
    "role",
    "consent",
    "year",
    "residence_type",
    "mode_primary"
]

for column in category_columns:
    print("\nValues in", column, ":")
    display(
        survey_clean[column]
        .value_counts(dropna=False)
        .to_frame("rows")
    )


```
